theorems.name: Submission.lipts_rectifiable_tangent_chart_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (N : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ)) (T : ℕ → Amb n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (N k)) ∧ (∀ k, (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (N k) < ⊤) ∧ (∀ k, ContinuousOn (fun x => (T k x).starProjection) (N k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ N k, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (N k) x (T k x)) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (M \ ⋃ k, N k) = 0
